View less classifications",,HENAN AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY河南农业大学,CUI XIAONA崔晓娜ZHANG HAIRONG张海荣CAO YUANYUAN曹园园ZHOU SHUHAO周舒浩LI ZIWEN李子文,郑州盈派知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 41196郑州盈派知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 41196,(EN) Application of ESD4 gene in plant salt stress resistance regulation and control(ZH) ESD4基因在植物盐胁迫抗性调控中的应用,"(EN) The invention discloses an application of an ESD4 gene in plant salt stress resistance regulation and control, and aims to solve the technical problem that the current plant salt tolerance improvement and salt-tolerant plant variety breeding are lack of effective technical means. Researches find that the tolerance of plants to salt stress can be increased by function deficiency or low expression of ESD4; and by identifying the arabidopsis thaliana ESD4 function deletion point mutant, the salt stress resistance of the mutant is obviously improved compared with that of a wild type. The ESD4 gene is knocked out or the expression of the ESD4 gene is reduced through the CRISPR-Cas9 technology, a non-transgenic editing mutant without insertion of an exogenous transformation vector can be obtained, and popularization and application in crops are facilitated.(ZH) 本申请公开了一种ESD4基因在植物盐胁迫抗性调控中的应用，旨在解决当前植物耐盐性提高及耐盐植物品种选育缺乏有效技术手段的技术问题。本申请研究发现ESD4的功能缺失或低表达能够增加植物对盐胁迫的耐受；并通过鉴定拟南芥ESD4功能缺失点突变体，发现突变体与野生型相比对盐胁迫的抗性明显提高。通过CRISPR‑Cas9技术对ESD4基因进行敲除或降低其表达的编辑，能获得没有外源转化载体插入的非转基因编辑突变体，更利于在作物中推广应用。",,,,,,,,,,

SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a method of obtaining a potato plant with biallelic mutations in the coding region of EDR1 gene using CRISPR/Cas9 plant genome editing technology. The method involves obtaining a construct pKSE401-EDR1-1-2-1 containing the nucleotide sequence of an RNA conductor, transferring this construct into potato cells using Agrobacterium tumefaciens to introduce mutations in the coding region of the EDR1 gene, and selecting regenerative plants with biallelic mutations in the coding region of EDR1 gene.
EFFECT: invention is effective for producing potato plants using the above method.

The research of the inventor finds that the SRB gene is related to the resistance of the spodoptera frugiperda to the Vip3Aa protein, and when the SRB gene is expressed, the spodoptera frugiperda is sensitive to the Vip3Aa protein; the SRB strain is knocked out through gene editing CRISPR/Cas9, and a biological assay result shows that compared with wild type spodoptera frugiperda, the knockout SRB strain generates 315 times of resistance to Vip3Aa protein. Therefore, as a functional receptor of the Vip3Aa protein, the scavenger receptor protein SRB can be used as a resistance monitoring target to monitor the resistance level of field grassland spodoptera frugiperda to the Vip3Aa protein. The research result can also be used for research and development of novel Bt crops and comprehensive treatment of resistance of pests to Bt crops/Bt preparations.(ZH) 本发明提供了一种SRB基因在调控草地贪夜蛾对Vip3Aa蛋白抗性中的应用，涉及生物技术领域。经发明人研究发现，SRB基因与草地贪夜蛾对Vip3Aa蛋白的抗性有关，表达SRB基因，草地贪夜蛾对Vip3Aa蛋白敏感；通过基因编辑CRISPR/Cas9对其进行敲除，生物测定结果显示，较野生型草地贪夜蛾，敲除SRB品系对Vip3Aa蛋白产生了315倍的抗性。因此，清道夫受体蛋白SRB，作为Vip3Aa蛋白的功能受体，可以作为抗性监测靶标来监测田间草地贪夜蛾对Vip3Aa蛋白的抗性水平。该研究结果还可用于新型Bt作物的研发、害虫对Bt作物/Bt制剂抗性的综合治理。",,,,,,,,,,
